 Amazon shoppers are snapping up this K-Beauty toner that’s now under £16 
 Scott Da Silva-Wells 
 Published November 19, 2026 1:00pm 
 Share this article via whatsapp Share this article via x Copy the link to this article. Link is copied Share this article via facebook 
 Is your skin looking congested and lack-luster? Well add these pads into your skincare routine. (Picture: Metro/PLANTIFIQUE/Amazon) 
 Metro journalists select and curate the products that feature on our site. If you make a purchase via links on this page we will earn commission – learn more 
 The change in temperature can wreak havoc on our skin, with chilly winds outside and the blast of central heating inside leaving complexions feeling dry, tight and decidedly less than glowy.
 So, as the seasons change, it’s worth giving our skincare routine a little extra TLC – whether that means adding a nourishing formula, switching up a few products or investing in something that helps keep our skin feeling happy and hydrated.
 One easy addition is a toner , which sits between your cleanser and serum to prep the skin for the rest of your routine, while also helping to target specific concerns.
 And one that’s currently getting plenty of love from shoppers is the Plantifique Glycolic Acid Toner , which usually costs £19.93 but is currently reduced to £15.15 as part of Amazon’s Black Friday offers , running from November 19 to 25.
 PLANTIFIQUE Glycolic Acid Toner Pads with Centella & Niacinamide, 60 Pcs
 The Plantifique Glycolic Acid Toner Pads are pre-soaked exfoliating pads infused with a blend of glycolic acid (AHA), salicylic acid (BHA) and PHA to help remove dead skin cells, refine the appearance of pores and boost radiance. 
Designed to be quick and easy to use, they're a fuss-free addition to any skincare routine, particularly for anyone looking to tackle dullness and achieve smoother, brighter-looking skin.
 Buy Now for £15.15 (was £19.93) – save 24% 
 The toner taps into one of the biggest beauty trends around – K-Beauty, or Korean skincare – and packs three exfoliating acids into one handy step.
 There’s AHA in the form of glycolic acid, BHA (salicylic acid) and PHA (gluconolactone), alongside centella asiatica and tea tree oil. Together, the formula is designed to help remove dead skin cells from the surface, refine the appearance of pores and leave skin looking smoother, fresher and more radiant.
 And because nobody needs another complicated 12-step skincare routine, the formula comes in handy pre-soaked pads, making application quick, easy and considerably less messy.
 Minimise pores and sebaceous filaments with the PLANTIFIQUE Glycolic Acid Toner Pads with Centella & Niacinamide. (Picture: Metro/PLANTIFIQUE/Amazon) 
 If you’re new to exfoliating acids, however, it’s worth easing yourself in rather than going in all guns blazing. Start by using the pads around twice a week, gradually building up frequency as your skin becomes accustomed to the formula.
Each pot also comes with tweezers to help pick up the delicate pads, while the refillable shell is designed with reducing waste in mind.
 It seems shoppers are pretty impressed, too.
 Ask Metro
 Use AI to go deeper into the stories you care about – powered by Metro and trusted publications. 
 One reviewer wrote: ‘I love these . I’ve bought them twice now. They leave your skin feeling really refreshing. I use them twice a day and have noticed a bit of difference in my skin so far, compared to using other products to try and reduce my pores. Highly recommended.’
 You can easily refil the pot once you have finished too. (Picture: Metro/PLANTIFIQUE/Amazon) 
 Another said: ‘I am really impressed with the Plantifique Peeling Pads ! They’re gentle on my more sensitive skin but still make a noticeable difference. My skin feels so much smoother and clean after using them. I definitely recommend these! A new staple in my skincare routine.’

 So, whether you’re looking to get your glow on ahead of party season or simply want to give a lacklustre winter complexion a little extra love, the Plantifique Glycolic Acid Toner could be an easy addition to your routine – particularly while you can pick it up for less than £16.
